data.one_liner: Flutter SDK for Omise payment API with built‑in UI components
data.what_it_does: Provides tokenization, source creation, and payment flows for Omise. Includes UI screens for card, Google Pay, Apple Pay, and other APMs. Supports i18n and debugging options.
use_when: You need to accept payments via Omise in a Flutter app
You want a ready‑made UI for payment methods
You need source creation for promptpay or mobile banking
avoid_when: You already have a custom payment integration
You need a lightweight library without UI components
strengths: All-in-one SDK with UI and API
Supports multiple payment methods and i18n
weaknesses: Not suitable for non‑Omise payment gateways
data.setup_notes: Add omise_flutter to pubspec, provide Omise public/private keys, no build_runner needed
data.minimal_example:
final omisePayment = OmisePayment(publicKey: "pkey", enableDebug: true, locale: OmiseLocale.en);
await omisePayment.selectPaymentMethod(amount: 2000, currency: Currency.thb);
